endpoints.name: Z_InventoryOptimizationHeader_SRV
endpoints.description: Core header service providing aggregated stock snapshots per storage location group.

Z_inv_opt_header.description: High-level dashboard view aggregating stock by Storage Location Group (VORWA). Designed for ListReports and AnalysisPages.

Z_mat_stock_details.description: Detailed transactional view combining Master Data (MARA/MARD), Stock, Movements, and Vendor Info.

inbound_stock_update_flow.description: Maps Supplier API JSON payloads to SAP internal OData V4 structure for automatic stock posting.

outbound_alert_flow.description: Transforms low-stock alerts from CDS view to SAP GUI IDoc or External REST Consumer.

performance_notes.view_optimization: All joins are executed on HANA in-memory within CDS views.
performance_notes.caching_strategy: First N results cached for ListReports to reduce backend load.
